_RAJ2000.description: Right ascension (FK5, Equinox=J2000.0) (computed by VizieR, not part of the original data. The format may include more digits than the original data because of internal accuracy requirements in VizieR and across other CDS services)

_DEJ2000.description: Declination (FK5, Equinox=J2000.0) (computed by VizieR, not part of the original data. The format may include more digits than the original data because of internal accuracy requirements in VizieR and across other CDS services)

recno.description: Record number assigned by the VizieR team. Should Not be used for identification.

IAUName.description: eROSITA String containing the official IAU name of the source (IAUNAME)

IdSrc.description: eROSITA Source ID in each sky tile (ID_SRC)

UId5XMM.description: XMM-Newton 5XMM-DR15 catalogue SRCID of the associated source: positive for strong associations, negative for weak ones; 0 indicates no counterpart, and -1 denotes sources outside the 5XMM footprint (UID_5XMM)

UId2RXS.description: 2RXS catalogue IND_2RXS of the associated source: positive for strong associations, negative for weak ones; 0 indicates no counterpart.(UID_2RXS)

UIdCSC.description: Chandra CSC 2.1 catalogue name of the associated source: positive for strong associations, negative for weak ones; 0 indicates no counterpart, and -1 denotes sources outside the Chandra CSC 2.1 footprint.(UID_CSC)

UIdDR1Hard.description: ? eROSITA DR1 Hard catalog UID of the source with a strong association, or -UID if the association is weak (UID_DR1Hard)

IdCluster.description: ? eROSITA Group ID of simultaneously fitted sources (ID_CLUSTER)

RADEErr.description: ? eROSITA Combined positional error, raw output from PSF fitting (RADEC_ERR)

MLcts0.description: Source net counts measured from count rate at 0.2-5.0keV (ML_CTS_0)

MLRate0.description: Source count rate measured by forced PSF-fitting at 0.2-5.0keV (ML_RATE_0)

MLFlux0.description: Source flux converted from count rate at 0.2-5.0keV (ML_FLUX_0)

DetLike0.description: Detection likelihood measured by forced forced PSF-fitting at 0.2-5.0keV (DET_LIKE_0)

MLbkg0.description: Background at the source position at 0.2-5.0keV (ML_BKG_0)

FSpSNR.description: [0/1] Source may lie within an overdense region near a supernova remnant (FLAG_SP_SNR)

FSpBPS.description: [0/1] Source may lie within an overdense region near a bright point source (FLAG_SP_BPS)

FSpSCL.description: [0/1] Source may lie within an overdense region near a stellar cluster (FLAG_SP_SCL)

FSpLGA.description: [0/1] Source may lie within an overdense region near a local large galaxy (FLAG_SP_LGA)

FSpGCCons.description: [0/1] Source may lie within an overdense region near a galaxy cluster (FLAG_SP_GC_CONS)

FNoRADEerr.description: [0/1] Source contained no RADEC_ERR in the pre-processed version of the catalogue (FLAG_NO_RADEC_ERR)

FNoExterr.description: [0/1] Source contained no EXT_ERR in the pre-processed version of the catalogue (FLAG_NO_EXT_ERR)

FNoctserr.description: [0/1] Source contained no CTS_ERR in the pre-processed version of the catalogue (FLAG_NO_CTS_ERR)

FOpt.description: [0/1] Source matched within 15'' with a bright optical star, likely contaminated by optical loading (FLAG_OPT)

LS10rel.description: ? LS10 Integer denoting the camera and filter set used, which will be unique for a given processing run of the data (LS10_RELEASE)

LS10objid.description: ? Catalog object number within this brick (LS10_OBJID)

LS10fullid.description: Unique LS10 identifier (a unique identifier has release_brickid_objid (LS10_FULLID)

EROLS10FId.description: Unique identifier of X-ray source + LS10 Counterpart (ERO_LS10_FULLID)

LS10Xpr.description: ? Probability to be an X-ray emitter usibf LS10 prior (LS10_Xray_proba)

SepLS10ERO.description: ? Separation between LS10 and eROSITA source (NWAY_Separation_LS10_ERO)

distbayfac.description: ? Logarithm of ratio between prior and posterior, from separation, positional error and number density (NWAY_dist_bayesfactor)

distpost.description: ? Distance posterior probability comparing this association vs. no association (NWAY_dist_post)

biasLS10Xpr.description: ? Prior Probability weighting. A value of 1 indicates no change from probability due to astrometry (see paper) (NWAY_bias_LS10_Xray_proba)

psingle.description: ? Same as dist_post, but weighted by the prior (NWAY_p_single)

pany.description: ? For each entry in the X-ray catalogue, the probability that there is a counterpart (NWAY_p_any)

pi.description: ? Relative probability of the eROSITA/LS10 match (NWAY_p_i)

matchflag.description: ? assuming ncat==2: 1 best counterpart; 2 alternative good counterpart (NWAY_match_flag)

thresh8.description: ? p_any value at the intersection between purity and completeness for DET_LIKE_0>=8 (NWAY_threshold8)

compur8.description: ? Value of Purity and Completeness at the intersection point for DET_LIKE_0>=8 (NWAY_compur8)

purity8.description: ? Purity at the value of p_any for DET_LIKE_0>=8 (NWAY_purity8)

comp8.description: ? Completeness at the value of p_any for DET_LIKE_0>=8 (NWAY_completeness8)

RALivar.description: ? Inverse variance of RA (no cosine term!), excluding astrometric calibration errors (LS10_RA_IVAR)

DELivar.description: ? Inverse variance of DEC, excluding astrometric calibration errors (LS10_DEC_IVAR)

dchi2SF1.description: ? Difference in chi^2^ between more-complex model fits PSSF (LS10_DCHISQ)

dchi2SF2.description: ? Difference in chi^2^ between more-complex model fits PSSF (LS10_DCHISQ)

dchi2SF3.description: ? Difference in chi^2^ between more-complex model fits PSSF (LS10_DCHISQ)

dchi2SF4.description: ? Difference in chi^2^ between more-complex model fits PSSF (LS10_DCHISQ)

dchi2SF5.description: ? Difference in chi^2^ between more-complex model fits PSSF (LS10_DCHISQ)

E(B-V).description: ? Galactic extinction E(B-V) reddening from SFD98, used to compute the mw_transmission_columns (LS10_EBV)

Fg.description: ? model flux in g in nanomaggy (LS10_FLUX_G)

Fr.description: ? model flux in r in nanomaggy (LS10_FLUX_R)

Fi.description: ? model flux in i in nanomaggy (LS10_FLUX_I)

Fz.description: ? model flux in z in nanomaggy (LS10_FLUX_Z)

FW1.description: ? WISE model flux in W1 (AB system) in nanomaggy (LS10_FLUX_W1)

FW2.description: ? WISE model flux in W2 (AB) in nanomaggy (LS10_FLUX_W2)

FW3.description: ? WISE model flux in W3 (AB) in nanomaggy (LS10_FLUX_W3)

FW4.description: ? WISE model flux in W4 (AB) in nanomaggy (LS10_FLUX_W4)

FW1ivar.description: ? Inverse variance of flux_W1 in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (AB system) (LS10_FLUX_IVAR_W1)

MWtransg.description: ? Galactic transmission in g filter in linear units [0, 1] (LS10_MW_TRANSMISSION_G)

MWtransr.description: ? Galactic transmission in r filter in linear units [0, 1] (LS10_MW_TRANSMISSION_R)

MWtransi.description: ? Galactic transmission in i filter in linear units [0, 1] (LS10_MW_TRANSMISSION_I)

MWtransz.description: ? Galactic transmission in z filter in linear units [0, 1] (LS10_MW_TRANSMISSION_Z)

MWtransW1.description: ? Galactic transmission in W1 filter in linear units [0, 1] (LS10_MW_TRANSMISSION_W1)

MWtransW2.description: ? Galactic transmission in W2 filter in linear units [0, 1] (LS10_MW_TRANSMISSION_W2)

MWtransW3.description: ? Galactic transmission in W3 filter in linear units [0, 1] (LS10_MW_TRANSMISSION_W3)

MWtransW4.description: ? Galactic transmission in W4 filter in linear units [0, 1] (LS10_MW_TRANSMISSION_W4)

anymaskg.description: ? Bitwise mask set if the central pixel from any image satisfies each condition in g as catalogued on the DR10 bitmasks page (ANYMASK_G)

anymaskr.description: ? Bitwise mask set if the central pixel from any image satisfies each condition in r as catalogued on the DR10 bitmasks page (ANYMASK_R)

anymaski.description: ? Bitwise mask set if the central pixel from any image satisfies each condition in i as catalogued on the DR10 bitmasks page (ANYMASK_I)

anymaskz.description: ? Bitwise mask set if the central pixel from any image satisfies each condition in z as catalogued on the DR10 bitmasks page (ANYMASK_Z)

allmaskg.description: ? Bitwise mask set if the central pixel from all images satisfy each condition in g as catalogued on the DR10 bitmasks page (LS10_allmask_g)

allmaskr.description: ? Bitwise mask set if the central pixel from all images satisfy each condition in r as catalogued on the DR10 bitmasks page (LS10_allmask_r)

allmaski.description: ? Bitwise mask set if the central pixel from all images satisfy each condition in i as catalogued on the DR10 bitmasks page (LS10_allmask_i)

allmaskz.description: ? Bitwise mask set if the central pixel from all images satisfy each condition in z as catalogued on the DR10 bitmasks page (LS10_allmask_z)

WISEmaskW1.description: ? W1 bitmask as catalogued on the DR10 bitmasks page (LS10_wisemask_w1)

WISEmaskW2.description: ? W2 bitmask as catalogued on the DR10 bitmasks page (LS10_wisemask_w2)

PSFsizeg.description: ? Weighted average PSF FWHM in the g band (LS10_psfsize_g)

PSFsizer.description: ? Weighted average PSF FWHM in the r band (LS10_psfsize_r)

PSFsizei.description: ? Weighted average PSF FWHM in the i band (LS10_psfsize_i)

PSFsizez.description: ? Weighted average PSF FWHM in the z band (LS10_psfsize_z)

PSFdepthg.description: ? For a 5 sigma point source detection limit in g in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (LS10_psfdepth_g)

PSFdepthr.description: ? For a 5 sigma point source detection limit in r in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (LS10_psfdepth_r)

PSFdepthi.description: ? For a 5 sigma point source detection limit in i in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (LS10_psfdepth_i)

PSFdepthz.description: ? For a 5 sigma point source detection limit in z in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (LS10_psfdepth_z)

PSFdepthW1.description: ? As for psfdepth_g (and also on the AB system) but for WISE W1 in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (LS10_psfdepth_w1)

PSFdepthW2.description: ? As for psfdepth_g (and also on the AB system) but for WISE W2 in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (LS10_psfdepth_w2)

Galdepthg.description: ? As for psfdepth_g but for a galaxy (0.45" exp, round) detection sensitivity in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (LS10_galdepth_g)

Galdepthr.description: ? As for psfdepth_r but for a galaxy (0.45" exp, round) detection sensitivity in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (LS10_galdepth_r)

Galdepthi.description: ? As for psfdepth_i but for a galaxy (0.45" exp, round) detection sensitivity in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (LS10_galdepth_i)

Galdepthz.description: ? As for psfdepth_z but for a galaxy (0.45" exp, round) detection sensitivity in 1/nanomaggy^2^ (LS10_galdepth_z)

Sersic.description: ? LS10 Power-law index for the Sersic profile model (type="SER") (LS10_sersic)

Shaper.description: ? Half-light radius of galaxy model for galaxy type type (>0) (LS10_shape_r)

ShapeE1.description: ? Ellipticity component 1 of galaxy model for galaxy type type (LS10_shape_e1)

ShapeE2.description: ? Ellipticity component 2 of galaxy model for galaxy type type (LS10_shape_e2)

RFG.description: ? Gaia DR3 G-band mean flux divided by its error (GDR3_phot_g_mean_flux_over_error)

BPmag.description: ? Gaia DR3 Integrated BP mean magnitude (GDR3_phot_bp_mean_mag)

RFBP.description: ? Gaia DR3 Integrated BP mean flux divided by its error (GDR3_phot_bp_mean_flux_over_error)

RPmag.description: ? Gaia DR3 Integrated RP mean magnitude (GDR3_phot_rp_mean_mag)

RFRP.description: ? Gaia DR3 Integrated RP mean flux divided by its error (GDR3_phot_rp_mean_flux_over_error)

pmRA.description: ? Gaia DR3 Proper motion in right ascension direction, pmRA*cosDE (GDR3_pmra)

pmDE.description: ? Gaia DR3 Proper motion in declination direction (GDR3_pmdec)

g0mag.description: ? AB magnitude, Milky Way attenuation corrected, g band (dered_mag_g)

r0mag.description: ? AB magnitude, Milky Way attenuation corrected, r band (dered_mag_r)

z0mag.description: ? AB magnitude, Milky Way attenuation corrected, z band (dered_mag_z)

W10mag.description: ? AB magnitude, Milky Way attenuation corrected, W1 band (dered_mag_W1)

W20mag.description: ? AB magnitude, Milky Way attenuation corrected, W2 band (dered_mag_W2)

W1-Xld.description: ? Salvato et al. (2018, Cat. J/MNRAS/473/4937) W1-X line distance (Salvato18_W1_X_linedistance)

zW1grld.description: ? Salvato et al. (2022, Cat. J/A+A/661/A3) zW1gr line distance (Salvato22_zW1gr_linedistance)

S18S.description: Has Salvato et al., (2018, Cat. J/MNRAS/473/4937) AGN colors? (has_Salvato18_AGN_colors)

S22S.description: Has Salvato et al., (2022, Cat. J/A+A/661/A3) AGN colors? (has_Salvato22_AGN_colors)

GpmSNR.description: ? Gaia proper motion RA and DEC, each divided by error, added in quadrature (Gaia_PM_SNR)

Gmov5sigma.description: Gaia motion >5sigma significant in either parallax or proper motion (see paper) (Gaia_moving_5sigma)

SimbadName.description: Simbad ID of source with a max distance of 1 arcsec from LS10 (main_id_simbad)

Skngal.description: known X-ray binary or CV in simbad within 1 arcsec of LS10 position (simbad_known_galactic)

isBlinS.description: It is a Blazar in Simbad (max distance of 1 arcsec from LS10 source) (is_blazar_in_simbad)

BZcat.description: ? ID from the Blazar catalog BZcat(2009) (id_bzcat)

RAB.description: BZcat Right Ascension in (hh mm ss.ss) (RAJ2000_bzcat)

ExgalpGS.description: ? Probability to be Extragalactic from STAREX, using Gaia (see paper) (Exgal_prob_Gaia_STAREX)

ExgalpnGS.description: ? Probability to be Extragalactic from STAREX, omitting Gaia (see paper) (Exgal_prob_noGaia_STAREX)

ExgalpS.description: ? Probability to be Extragalactic from STAREX (Exgal_prob_STAREX)

ClGalExgal.description: Negative values for stars, positive for extragalactic (see paper) (class_gal_exgal)

ClJetted.description: indicator if known blazar source within 1 arcsec of LS10 position: 1: bzcat, 2: crates, 3: is_blazar_in_simbad (class_jetted)
